## unit

### `tests/unit/ai-client.test.ts`

- loads the versioned prompt and checks the answer; one ok row
- a malformed answer is an error row and an AiOutputError, never a crash or a guess
- retries a busy endpoint, then records the one call that answered
- does not retry a plain failure: one error row
- gives up after the timeout with a timeout row
- is unavailable without a model ID, and makes no row
- prices a call from the env (USD per million tokens = micro-USD per token)
- a text call uses the versioned ask prompt, sends no image, and records one ok row
- the stand-in answers from the record that shares the question’s words, cited, or says not found
- embeddings: one row per batch; null without a model; the stand-in puts similar words close
- a failing embedding endpoint is an error row and words-only search, never a throw
- prices by the call kind

### `tests/unit/bill-compute.test.ts`

- one rate on everything for a regular business within the state
- IGST across states; per-line rates honoured
- never taxes a composition business or a bill with GST switched off
- treats an unparsable field as zero and a blank line as worthless, never NaN
- says when the pack has no rule for the date instead of crashing (a 2016 photo date)
- marks an overflow instead of crashing the form
- offers the rule pack’s rates for the bill’s date (I5)
- builds a brand-new owner’s business from the setup answers
- the form, the paper and the GST workings agree on a fixture bill
- every fixture bill was computed by the engine (no second tax calculation in the generator)

### `tests/unit/bill-gst-lines.test.ts`

- lines at different rates come back per line
- lines at one rate come back as one rate
- a line with no rate takes the business’s default, and none at all gives the default
- a blank first row leaves each line its own per-line rate
- a different name drops the State the added customer lent; their name brings it back
- a State the owner chose stays; with nothing lent the name is all that changes
- follows the lines as edited: a fixed rate makes the note go

- carry the year the number belongs to, with any other query after it

### `tests/unit/engine-assess.test.ts`

- allows an ordinary domestic supply by a regular registrant, and names the rules it read
- allows an unregistered business to bill without GST
- a registered business can make one bill without GST: a bill of supply (s. 31(3)(c)), no tax lines, no legend
- a composition business issues a bill of supply with the legend, and may not charge tax (adapted: the MVP refused composition)
- a composition business may not supply to another State (s. 10(2)(c)); its own State is fine
- blocks until the GST status is known
- blocks an unsupported supply type: %s
- blocks a regular registrant with no GSTIN, no state or no confirmed place of supply
- refuses a rate the law does not have on the bill’s date (selectable-rates-gst2), and keeps the old ones for old dates
- refuses to print a tax invoice with a rate nobody chose, and counts them
- a tax invoice where every line is 0 % is refused: it is a bill of supply (s. 31(3)(c); Stage 3 review)
- does not ask a business that charges no GST for a rate
- e-invoicing: unscreened blocks, self-declared passes, above the threshold blocks, exempt passes (e-invoice-threshold-2023)
- e-invoicing is for B2B only (scope b2b): a walk-in’s bill neither blocks nor is noted
- the 30-day IRN window (irn-30-day-2025): a ₹10 crore business cannot report a bill older than 30 days
- HSN digits by turnover band (hsn-digits-2021): short codes block, absent codes are said
- B2C of ₹50,000 or more needs the name, address and state (b2c-recipient-details-r46)
- a credit note must link its invoice and reduce tax within the date limit (credit-note-declare-limit)
- refuses a customer GSTIN that is the business’s own
- reads a custom pack when one is passed
- reverse charge is not issued in this release; an ordinary supply is
- a regular business switching GST off is told it makes a bill of supply
- a self-declared e-invoicing exemption is noted, not blocked
- the customer's GSTIN state against the place of supply is asked about, never refused
- a bill dated within a month of a rate change says its own date decides the rates
- every check with a rule has a "Kyun?" in both registers
